::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 30th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 233-4
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
I shall see [Miss Johns](people/person_887.qmd) on Saturday and have a consultation with her.

I have been prevented from setting about the [Storehouse](cmy_books/cmybook_83.qmd) by the almost sudden death - the first day of this month - of [one](people/person_1582.qmd) of my dear cousins - the one on whom I relied for looking out the copies of the books that I was to have from [Puslinch](organizations/other_123.qmd). I have not been willing to trouble her [sister](people/person_1626.qmd) to hunt them out - and I am afraid the [Elements of Morality](other_books/otherbook_557.qmd) cannot be had anywhere else. (I do not mean the [Blossoms of Morality](other_books/otherbook_556.qmd)). I will however ask for it in a day or two.

One or two more questions before I definitely arrange. Shall we have [Goody Two Shoes](other_books/otherbook_555.qmd). It is more of a classic than any other, but has been often reprinted - spoiling the ghost, and can it be made out if [Philip Quarl](other_books/otherbook_549.qmd) is Defoe’s - I cannot find it in the list of his works.[^1]

Also after how many years is it safe to take no notice of copy right. What is to be done about [illustrations](organizations/other_167.qmd) and in borrowing the books that cannot be bought. What assurance can I give of their being returned uninjured or must I get them copies. [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd) shewed me a copy of Blossoms of Morality with cuts by [Bewick](people/person_2050.qmd). I thought of taking a few of the stories, can the illustrations to them be copied.

I think I must ask to know all this before I can fairly arrange the list of books, but I am writing for some that I can borrow. The post has not yet brought [M. Huard](people/person_2051.qmd)’s designs. I must write again when they come. I believe the [second part of Historical Selections](cmy_books/cmybook_82.qmd) is almost ready

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: All the stories mentioned here were included in either the first or second *Storehouse of Stories*.
